title: Trusted Baby Experts, Helplines and Parenting Resources
description: Trusted places to turn: official baby health sites, free UK and US helplines, and well-known paediatricians and parenting experts to follow.
intro: The internet is full of baby advice. These are official sources, free helplines and well-known experts we think are worth your time. We are independent and not affiliated with any of them.

image.alt: A smiling woman carrying a baby

sections.h2: How we choose who to list
sections.html: We only list organisations and people we have checked are real and active, and we link to their official websites. We don't receive anything for these listings. Some creators sell courses or products; that is their business, and you don't need to buy anything to benefit from their free content. If a source disagrees with your own midwife, health visitor or paediatrician, go with the professional who knows your child.

faqs.a: Some are qualified professionals and many share helpful experience, but social media isn’t personal medical advice. Check health questions against official sources like the NHS, CDC or AAP and your own health professional.
